payload.claim: test_a_phase_or_terminal_detail_is_clipped's fixture (`long_detail = "x" * (_DETAIL_BOUND + 400)`, `clipped = "x" * _DETAIL_BOUND`) is a uniform run of one character, so it cannot distinguish a correct prefix-preserving clip from a suffix-preserving one — both `str[:limit]` and `str[-limit:]` produce the identical 500-'x' string. Changing `saffron/events.py`'s `_clean` from `[:limit]` to `[-limit:]` leaves this test, and every other clip-boundary test in the file (all of which also use homogeneous filler), green, while a real long validation error rendered through the new `PhaseStart`/`Terminal` call sites would show only its last 500 characters instead of the diagnostic beginning the acceptance criterion ("renders as one bounded line rather than whole") is meant to keep legible. This is a pre-existing gap in `_clean`'s own test coverage that this diff extends to two new, more consequential call sites without closing it; the actual code is correct today, which is why this is a note rather than a concern.
